"""Tests for "Understand this website": page discovery, the brief's checks and the run's lifecycle. Usage: python -m unittest test_understand -v Nothing here touches the job queue or the database, and no model is called: the brief's model call is a stand-in that returns whatever a test wants (including things a model must not be believed about). The sites are small servers on loopback; 127.0.0.1 is treated as public for them (as in test_egress.py), while 127.0.0.2 and the metadata address stay private. One live test drives a real Chrome behind the guard for a page that needs JavaScript; SKIP_LIVE_TESTS=1 skips it. """ import asyncio import ipaddress import os import unittest from pathlib import Path from unittest import mock from dotenv import load_dotenv load_dotenv(Path(__file__).parent / ".env") import egress # noqa: E402 import site_reader # noqa: E402 import understand # noqa: E402 from site_reader import PageRead, SiteRead # noqa: E402 REAL_IS_BLOCKED = egress.is_blocked_address TEST_ORIGIN = ipaddress.ip_address("127.0.0.1") def origin_is_public(address): return False if address == TEST_ORIGIN else REAL_IS_BLOCKED(address) FILLER = ("This sentence is here so the page has enough visible text to count as a real page and not a shell " "that scripts fill in later. ") def html(title: str, body: str, links: str = "") -> str: return (f"{title}" f"
{links}

{title}

{body}

{FILLER * 4}

") class Site: """A tiny web server: path -> html (or (status, content type, body, extra headers)); counts requests.""" def __init__(self, routes: dict, host: str = "127.0.0.1"): self.routes, self.host, self.requests, self.port = routes, host, [], 0 async def __aenter__(self): async def handle(reader, writer): try: head = await reader.readuntil(b"\r\n\r\n") path = head.split(b" ", 2)[1].decode() self.requests.append(path) route = self.routes.get(path) if route is None: status, ctype, body, extra = 404, "text/html", "not found", "" elif isinstance(route, str): status, ctype, body, extra = 200, "text/html; charset=utf-8", route, "" else: status, ctype, body, extra = route data = body.encode() if isinstance(body, str) else body writer.write(f"HTTP/1.1 {status} X\r\nContent-Type: {ctype}\r\nContent-Length: {len(data)}\r\n" f"{extra}Connection: close\r\n\r\n".encode() + data) await writer.drain() except (ConnectionError, asyncio.IncompleteReadError, OSError): pass finally: writer.close() self.server = await asyncio.start_server(handle, self.host, 0) self.port = self.server.sockets[0].getsockname()[1] return self async def __aexit__(self, *exc): self.server.close() await self.server.wait_closed() @property def url(self) -> str: return f"http://{self.host}:{self.port}/" def pages_requested(self) -> list[str]: return [path for path in self.requests if path != "/robots.txt"] class FakeRenderer: def __init__(self, text: str = ""): self.text, self.rendered, self.closed = text, [], False async def render(self, url: str) -> str: self.rendered.append(url) return f"Rendered

{self.text}

" async def close(self) -> None: self.closed = True class FakeModel: def __init__(self, raw: dict): self.raw, self.prompts = raw, [] async def __call__(self, prompt: str) -> dict: self.prompts.append(prompt) return self.raw def raw_brief(**overrides) -> dict: brief = { "one_liner": "Acme tracks invoices.", "what_it_does": "Acme tracks invoices for small shops.", "who_its_for": "Small shops.", "how_it_works": "Connect your bank; it matches invoices.", "primary_value": "Never chase a late invoice again.", "pricing": {"status": "unclear", "note": "", "tiers": []}, "business_model": {"model": "unknown", "evidence": []}, "claims": [], "unknowns": [], "suggested_journeys": [], } brief.update(overrides) return brief def small_site(extra: dict | None = None) -> dict: routes = { "/": html("Acme", "Acme tracks invoices for small shops. Start your free trial today.", "About Features"), "/about": html("About Acme", "We are a team of six who hate late invoices."), "/features": html("Features", "Bank sync, reminders and reports."), } routes.update(extra or {}) return routes async def understand_with(site: Site, model: FakeModel, **kwargs) -> dict: kwargs.setdefault("delay", 0) kwargs.setdefault("renderer", FakeRenderer()) with mock.patch("egress.is_blocked_address", origin_is_public): return await understand.understand_site(site.url, "test-run", model_call=model, **kwargs) class NoPricingPage(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase): async def test_a_site_with_no_pricing_page_says_not_published_and_has_no_prices(self): # The model is wrong on purpose: it "published" a price that is on no page. model = FakeModel(raw_brief(pricing={"status": "published", "note": "", "tiers": [ {"name": "Pro", "price": "$29/month", "what_you_get": "Everything", "source_url": "{home}"}]})) async with Site(small_site()) as site: model.raw["pricing"]["tiers"][0]["source_url"] = site.url result = await understand_with(site, model) pricing = result["brief"]["pricing"] self.assertEqual(pricing["status"], "not_published") self.assertEqual(pricing["tiers"], []) self.assertIn("No pricing page", pricing["note"]) self.assertIn("What it costs.", result["brief"]["unknowns"]) async def test_a_price_that_is_not_in_the_cited_page_is_dropped_even_with_a_pricing_page(self): routes = small_site({ "/": html("Acme", "Invoices.", "Pricing"), "/pricing": html("Pricing", "Starter is $9 per month. Team is $29 per month."), }) async with Site(routes) as site: tiers = [ {"name": "Starter", "price": "$9 per month", "what_you_get": "One shop", "source_url": site.url + "pricing"}, {"name": "Team", "price": "$29 per month", "what_you_get": "Five shops", "source_url": site.url + "pricing"}, {"name": "Enterprise", "price": "$499 per month", "what_you_get": "Invented", "source_url": site.url + ## Understand mode

### 2026-10-12 — "Understand this website": a sourced product brief that feeds the test form

Built on the `understand` branch, separate from the report and run-page work. Not committed.

What it does:
- A second run kind, `understand`, claimed from the same queue (`runs.kind`). `worker_run.execute` hands it to `understand_run.execute_understand`; a test run is unchanged.
- `site_reader.py` reads the homepage and up to 8 same-site pages chosen by link text and path (pricing, product, features, about, docs, FAQ, customers, blog index), one of each kind first. Every request goes through the egress guard as an HTTP proxy, so private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses are refused and every redirect hop is vetted. Limits: robots.txt (and Crawl-delay), 1 s between requests, 9 pages, 600 kB per page, 120 s in all. The browser opens only for a page with under 400 characters of text, at most 3 times.
- `understand.py` writes the brief with one model call (`product_brief` span; `fetch_page` span per page; `understand_site` root). The model proposes and code decides: a claim needs a source URL that is a page read; "confirmed" needs a quote found in that page; a price is kept only if it is in the cited page; no pricing page and no verified price gives `not_published` with no tiers; the business model is always labelled inferred and needs quoted evidence; a journey must quote the call to action or claim it came from. Missing fields are `unknown`.
- Web: the home form has "Test my website" / "Understand this website"; `/brief/[id]` shows the brief with every claim's source and status; each suggested journey is editable in place and "Test this journey" opens the test form with url, goal and success prefilled. The test run stores `brief_run_id`. The test form gained an optional "What would success look like?" (appended to the goal).
- SQL: `supabase/schema.sql`, section "Understand mode" (`kind`, `brief`, `brief_run_id`, `enqueue_understand_run`). Must be run before the brief page works.

Verification:
- 35 new worker tests (`test_understand.py`): no pricing page gives `not_published` and no prices; private addresses (direct, metadata, loopback, a redirect, a link) are refused and never contacted; the page cap holds (9, and 3 when set); every claim has a source URL that was read; robots.txt, delay, byte and time caps; browser only when text is thin. One live test drives real Chrome through the guard.
- 7 new web tests (`brief-logic.test.ts`). Whole suites: 187 worker tests (24 live skipped with SKIP_LIVE_TESTS=1), 15 web tests, typecheck, lint and `next build` clean, `scan_secrets.py` 0 matches.
- Two real runs with the model, no queue: plausible.io (9 pages, pricing from the page, 12 claims each with a source, $0.003 to $0.01) and saucedemo.com (a script-drawn login page: one browser read, "unknown" for who it's for, `not_published`, 1 journey, $0.0006).

Not done / known limits:
- The brief page was type-checked and the home form's prefill was checked in the built app, but the brief page has not been looked at against a real database row; the SQL has not been run.
- A running worker from before this change would claim an understand run and treat it as a test run. Run the new worker, or hold the queue, before using the form.
- "Not published" means no pricing page was linked from the pages read, not that none exists.
- Word-level quote matching: a model could quote real words in a misleading context. The page link is there to check.
- No investor or accelerator assessment, competitor analysis or price analysis, by design.
EOF

content.text:
"Understand this website" is built and tested, but I haven't run the SQL, so the brief page has not been seen against a real database row. Nothing is committed.

## SQL
It's appended to `supabase/schema.sql` under "Understand mode". It must run before the brief page works:

```sql
alter table public.runs add column if not exists kind text not null default 'test'
  check (kind in ('test', 'understand'));
alter table public.runs add column if not exists brief jsonb;
alter table public.runs add column if not exists brief_run_id uuid
  references public.runs (id) on delete set null;
create index if not exists runs_brief_run_id_idx on public.runs (brief_run_id) where brief_run_id is not null;

create or replace function public.enqueue_understand_run(
  p_url text, p_ip_hash text, p_max_queued integer, p_max_per_hour integer
) returns jsonb language plpgsql security invoker set search_path = '' as $$
declare queued_count integer; recent_count integer; oldest_recent timestamptz; new_id uuid;
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('public.enqueue_web_run'));
  select count(*) into queued_count from public.runs where status = 'queued';
  if queued_count >= p_max_queued then return jsonb_build_object('error', 'queue_full'); end if;
  select count(*), min(created_at) into recent_count, oldest_recent
    from public.runs where ip_hash = p_ip_hash and created_at > now() - interval '1 hour';
  if recent_count >= p_max_per_hour then
    return jsonb_build_object('error', 'rate_limited',
      'retry_after_seconds', ceil(extract(epoch from (oldest_recent + interval '1 hour' - now())))::integer);
  end if;
  insert into public.runs (url, goal, source, ip_hash, kind, access_mode)
  values (p_url, 'Understand this website', 'web', p_ip_hash, 'understand', 'public')
  returning id into new_id;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', new_id);
end; $$;
revoke execute on function public.enqueue_understand_run(text, text, integer, integer) from public, anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.enqueue_understand_run(text, text, integer, integer) to service_role;
```

## What was built

**Worker**
- **Run kind:** `worker_run.execute` hands `kind = "understand"` runs to `understand_run.py`. Test runs are untouched.
- **Discovery:** `site_reader.py` reads the homepage plus up to 8 same-site pages, one of each kind first.
  - Every request goes through the egress guard, so private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses are refused, including on each redirect hop.
  - Limits: robots.txt and Crawl-delay honoured, 1 s between requests, 9 pages, 600 kB per page, 120 s in all.
  - The browser opens only when a page has under 400 characters of text, at most 3 times.
- **Brief:** `understand.py` makes one model call. Spans are `understand_site`, `fetch_page` per page, and `product_brief`.
  - The model proposes and code enforces. A claim needs a source URL that was actually read.
  - "Confirmed" needs a quote found in that page.
  - A price is kept only if it appears in the cited page.
  - With no pricing page and no verified price, pricing is `not_published` with no tiers.
  - The business model is always labelled inferred and needs quoted evidence.
  - A journey must quote the call to action or claim it came from.
  - Anything missing is `unknown`.

**Web**
- **Home form:** a two-option chooser, "Test my website" and "Understand this website". It prefills from the query string.
- **`/brief/[id]`:** journeys come first as the main call to action, each editable in place, with "Test this journey" opening the prefilled test form. Below them are the claims with status and source links, pricing, the inferred business model, and the unknowns.
- **Test run:** `POST /api/runs` now accepts `briefId` and `success` and records `brief_run_id`.
- **New field:** the test form gained an optional "What would success look like?", which is appended to the goal text.

## Verification
- **New tests:** 35 worker tests in `test_understand.py` and 7 web tests in `brief-logic.test.ts`. They cover your four cases: no pricing page gives "not published" and no prices; private addresses are refused and never contacted; the page cap holds; every claim has a source URL.
- **Whole suites:** 187 worker tests pass, 15 web tests pass, typecheck, lint and `next build` are clean, and `scan_secrets.py` found 0 matches in the tree and 41 commits. The worker run used `SKIP_LIVE_TESTS=1` (24 skipped); I ran the one live Chrome test for this feature separately and it passed.
- **Real runs:** two direct calls with the model, no queue.
  - plausible.io: 6 pages, 4 tiers verified against the homepage text, 12 claims each with a source, 5 journeys, $0.003.
  - saucedemo.com: a script-drawn login page that needed the browser. "Who it's for" came back unknown, pricing `not_published`, 1 journey, $0.0006.

## Things to know
- **Old worker risk:** a worker running pre-change code will claim an understand run and treat it as a test run. That applies to the eval worker on the shared queue, so run the new worker or hold the queue first.
- **"Not published":** it means no pricing page was linked from the pages read, not that none exists. The note on the brief says so.
- **Brief page:** it passed typecheck and build, and the home form's prefill was checked in the built app, but the brief page itself was not visually checked.
- **Shared-file edits:** `web/app/page.tsx`, `run-form.tsx`, `api/runs/route.ts`, `package.json` (test script) and `worker_run.py` are small edits that may conflict with the other session. Everything else is new files.
- **Quote matching:** it is at the word level, so real words used in a misleading context would pass. The source link is there to check.

content.text:
The brief page works against a real row, and the success value no longer goes into the goal text. Nothing is committed.

**Run id:** `8ca3896f-a3d8-475f-b810-5c9b6b98bb9e` (https://plausible.io). I inserted it with status `running` and processed only that id with a one-off script, so no worker could claim it. I read no env file; the script and web server took their Supabase settings from the worker's already-loaded environment.

## 1. Brief page against the real row
Checked at 1280 px and 390 px in headless Chrome with screenshots:
- **Layout:** no horizontal scroll at either width. The sections run in order: goals, what it is, pricing, business model, claims, unknowns, pages read.
- **Journeys:** they come first and are editable in place. I edited a goal and its success text, and the "Test this journey" link carried the edited text.
- **Prefill:** the test form opened with the URL, edited goal, edited success and the brief note filled in, with "Test my website" selected.
- **Claims, pricing, unknowns:** each claim shows its status badge and a source link. Pricing shows the tiers with sources, the business model is labelled inferred with quoted evidence, and the unknowns list displays.

**Fixed along the way:**
- **Cut-off descriptions:** tier descriptions were cut mid-word ("cons", "retenti"). They now cut at a word with an ellipsis.
- **Changelog as product page:** `/changelog` was read as the product page. Changelog, releases and status paths are no longer chosen.
- **Hollow briefs:** about half of the model's replies for this site left out fields (stopped early or hit the 4000-token limit), and the page then showed no claims or goals.
  - Every required field is now checked and the reply is re-asked up to 3 times; if it is still incomplete, the run fails rather than saving a hollow brief.
  - The token limit is 8000 and the prompt asks for a compact answer.
  - Goals that don't quote the pages get one more try.
  - Six regenerations afterwards all came back complete: 10 to 12 claims, 4 to 5 journeys, about $0.0026 each.
  - **Cost:** a run is now about $0.003 normally, up to about $0.006 when a retry is needed.

## 2. Success is its own value
- **Goal text:** `withSuccess` is removed, and the goal is stored as the user typed it.
- **Success value:** it travels as `success` in the query string and in the POST body, validated to at most 300 characters. It is not stored yet; `route.ts` leaves `successText` for the other session's field and column.
- **At merge:** keep the name `success`, use the other session's input, and drop the duplicate `success` textarea I added to `run-form.tsx`. Until then, a success value typed into my textarea is accepted but not used. This is noted in `hackathon.md`.

## Verification
- **Worker:** 192 tests pass (24 live skipped with `SKIP_LIVE_TESTS=1`).
- **Web:** 14 tests pass, with typecheck and lint clean.
- **Secret scan:** 0 matches in the tree and 45 commits.
- **Dev server:** stopped.

**Still open:**
- **Old worker:** a worker running pre-change code would still treat an understand run as a test run, so the new worker has to be the one on the queue.
- **Not checked:** I didn't visually check the brief page's failure state ("could not read") or the home form's Understand mode against the database.

## Understand mode

...

- **Success is its own value, not part of the goal.** The brief's journeys carry `goal` and `success` separately. They reach the test form as `?goal=...&success=...&brief=...` and `POST /api/runs` takes `success` as its own body field (validated, at most 300 characters) next to `briefId`. It is **not appended to the goal text** and is **not stored yet**: `app/api/runs/route.ts` leaves `successText` for the other branch's success-condition field (its column and the verifier). **At merge:** keep the query-string name `success` and the body name `success`; use the other branch's "What does success look like?" input for the form, and drop the duplicate `success` textarea this branch added to `run-form.tsx` (`app/home-form.tsx` passes `initial.success` into the form's defaults, so point that at the other branch's field).

All four conflicts are resolved and the merge is ready for you to stage and commit; nothing is committed or staged. No conflict markers remain anywhere in the tree, and all checks pass.

## How each conflict was resolved
- **`supabase/schema.sql`**: I took main's file whole and appended my "Understand mode" block unchanged at the end.
  - Main's worker_id/`claim_run(text)` block and REPORT V2 block each appear once, and so does Understand mode.
  - `enqueue_web_run` ends as a single 10-argument overload (`p_success_condition` last); I added none. The `drop function` lines earlier in the file are the existing history that retires older overloads.
  - `enqueue_understand_run` is new and separate.
- **`web/app/api/runs/route.ts`**: main's version plus `briefId`.
  - Success handling is main's `successCondition` with its validation and `p_success_condition`; my `success` body field and its validation are gone.
  - `briefId` is validated and recorded as `brief_run_id` after the run is queued.
- **`web/app/run-form.tsx`**: main's "What does success look like?" input (`successCondition`) is kept, and my duplicate textarea and `success` body field are removed.
  - The input gets `defaultValue={initial?.success}`, so a brief's journey fills main's field.
  - The query string still carries `success`, which is what `parseHomeParams` reads, and the form posts `successCondition`.
- **`hackathon.md`**: both sections are kept (Understand mode and Report v2), and no line of main's was removed.
  - I rewrote my success-condition note to say it is merged into the Report v2 field and that `success` is no longer a body field.
- **`worker/worker_run.py`**: it merged cleanly, and its diff against main is exactly my four-line `kind == "understand"` dispatch at the top of `execute`. Main's verdict, run facts and worker id handling is untouched. `understand_run.py` still matches main's `db.fail_run` and `_now`.

## Verification (after the merge)
- **Worker:** 240 tests pass (27 live skipped with `SKIP_LIVE_TESTS=1`). I ran the live Chrome render test for Understand separately and it passed.
- **Web:** 21 tests pass, typecheck clean, lint clean, and `next build` succeeds with `/api/briefs`, `/api/briefs/[id]` and `/brief/[id]` listed.
- **Secret scan:** 0 matches in the tree and 46 commits; no env files are tracked.

## Notes
- **To finish the merge:** `git add hackathon.md supabase/schema.sql web/app/api/runs/route.ts web/app/run-form.tsx`, then commit.
- **neatlogs 401:** the worker test output ended with a neatlogs "Failed to export spans batch code: 401, Unauthorized" message. The tests passed, so I left it; I didn't track down which test initialises neatlogs, and it may just be the key the tests load.
- **Not exercised end to end:** the success text going from a brief's journey into `success_condition` has not been run against the database. It is covered by the prefill check from before the merge and by main's own field and RPC, but not run together.

"""Execute one claimed "founder_brief" run: read the stored product brief it points at, write the founder
brief from it, save it on this run. Fetches nothing: the pages were read when the product brief was made.

The run's brief_run_id is the product brief's run. The result is saved in this run's own `brief` column
and the page finds it by the product brief's id.
"""

import traceback

import neatlogs

import db
import trace_safety
from costs import TokenTally
from founder_brief import UNDERSTAND_MODEL, founder_brief, usable_brief


async def _update(run_id: str, update: dict) -> None:
    await (await db.client()).table("runs").update(update).eq("id", run_id).execute()


async def _load_brief(source_id: str) -> dict | None:
    rows = (await (await db.client()).table("runs").select("brief, status, kind").eq("id", source_id)
            .eq("kind", "understand").execute()).data
    return rows[0]["brief"] if rows and rows[0].get("status") == "done" else None


async def execute_founder_brief(run: dict, agent_version: str, *, load=_load_brief, write=founder_brief,
                                update=_update) -> None:
    run_id, source_id = run["id"], run.get("brief_run_id")
    print(f"Claimed founder brief run {run_id} (from brief {source_id}, model {UNDERSTAND_MODEL}, "
          f"agent {agent_version})", flush=True)
    base = {"agent_version": agent_version, "brain_model": UNDERSTAND_MODEL}

    async def fail(message: str, error: str) -> None:
        await update(run_id, {**base, "status": "failed", "error": error[:2000], "finished_at": db._now(),
                              "brief": {"status": "could_not_write", "message": message}})

    brief = await load(source_id) if source_id else None
    if not usable_brief(brief):
        await fail("There is no finished product brief to write this from.", "no usable product brief")
        print(f"Founder brief run {run_id}: no usable product brief", flush=True)
        return
    usage = TokenTally()
    try:
        with neatlogs.identify(session_id=f"run_{run_id}"):

"""Tests for the founder brief.

Usage: python -m unittest test_founder_brief -v

No model is called and nothing is fetched: the model is a stand-in that returns whatever a test wants
(including things it must not be believed about), and the brief it works from is a stored product brief.
"""

import json
import re
import unittest
from unittest import mock

import founder_brief as fb

HOME = "https://acme.example/"
ABOUT = "https://acme.example/about"
PRICING = "https://acme.example/pricing"


def stored_brief() -> dict:
    return {
        "version": 1, "url": HOME, "one_liner": "Acme tracks invoices for small shops.",
        "what_it_does": "Matches invoices to bank payments.", "who_its_for": "Small shops.",
        "how_it_works": "Connect your bank.", "primary_value": "Never chase a late invoice.",
        "pricing": {"status": "published", "note": "", "source_urls": [PRICING],
                    "tiers": [{"name": "Starter", "price": "$9 /month", "what_you_get": "One shop",
                               "source_url": PRICING}]},
        "business_model": {"label": "inferred", "model": "Subscription after a free trial",
                           "evidence": [{"quote": "Start your free trial today.", "source_url": HOME}]},
        "claims": [
            {"claim": "More than 2,000 shops use Acme", "source_url": ABOUT, "status": "confirmed",
             "quote": "More than 2,000 shops use Acme every week."},
            {"claim": "Works with any bank", "source_url": HOME, "status": "inferred", "quote": ""},
            {"claim": "Replaces spreadsheets and QuickBooks", "source_url": HOME, "status": "confirmed",
             "quote": "Replace your spreadsheets and QuickBooks."},
            {"claim": "Might do payroll", "source_url": HOME, "status": "unknown", "quote": ""},
        ],
        "unknowns": ["Who funds the company."],
        "suggested_journeys": [{"goal": "Start a free trial", "success": "A welcome page",
                                "source_url": HOME, "basis": "call_to_action",
                                "basis_text": "Start your free trial today", "claim_to_test": False}],
        "pages": [
            {"url": HOME, "kind": "home", "title": "Acme", "method": "http", "status": 200, "bytes": 10},
            {"url": ABOUT, "kind": "about", "title": "About", "method": "http", "status": 200, "bytes": 10},
            {"url": PRICING, "kind": "pricing", "title": "Pricing", "method": "http", "status": 200, "bytes": 10},
        ],
        "skipped": [], "limits": {"seconds": 1, "browser_reads": 0, "stopped": None},
    }


def stmt(text: str, *refs: str) -> dict:
    return {"text": text, "refs": list(refs)}


def good_raw() -> dict:
    return {
        "executive_summary": {
            "building": stmt("Acme builds invoice tracking for small shops.", "c1", "p1"),
            "for_whom": stmt("Small shops.", "c1"),
            "problem": stmt("Late invoices are hard to chase.", "j1"),
            "solution": stmt("It matches invoices to bank payments.", "c3"),
            "business_model": stmt("Subscription after a free trial, as we read it.", "e1", "t1"),
        },
        "opportunity": {
            "problem": stmt("Shops track invoices in spreadsheets.", "c3"),
            "alternatives": [{"name": "QuickBooks", "refs": ["c3"]}, {"name": "Xero", "refs": ["c3"]}],
            "target_users": stmt("Owners of small shops.", "c1"),
            "why_different": stmt("It targets very small shops rather than accountants.", "c1"),
        },
        "product": {
            "core_features": [stmt("Bank matching.", "c3"), stmt("Invented feature.", "c99")],
            "maturity_signals": [stmt("A public pricing page with one plan.", "t1")],
        },
        "traction_refs": ["c1", "c2", "c3", "c4", "p1", "c99"],
        "missing_evidence": ["No revenue figures are shown.", "No named customers."],
        "risks": {
            "technical": [stmt("Bank connections depend on third-party access.", "c2")],
            "competitive": [stmt("Established accounting tools already do this.", "c3")],
            "go_to_market": [stmt("The site gives no sign of how shops will find it.")],
        },
        "readiness": [
            {"dimension": key, "shows": [stmt(f"Public evidence for {key}.", "c1")], "unknown": ["Not stated."],
             "question": "What would you show someone to prove this?"}
            for key in fb.DIMENSION_KEYS
        ],
    }


def all_strings(value, skip=("quote",), path=()):
    """Every string in the output with its key path, except values under the skipped keys."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, item in value.items():
            if key in skip:
                continue
            yield from all_strings(item, skip, path + (key,))
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for index, item in enumerate(value):
            yield from all_strings(item, skip, path + (index,))
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        yield path, value


def all_keys(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, item in value.items():
            yield key
            yield from all_keys(item)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for item in value:
            yield from all_keys(item)


class NoScoreAnywhere(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_clean_report_has_no_score_rating_or_percentage_and_is_not_empty(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), stored_brief(), "b1")
        self.assertIn("Acme builds invoice tracking", out["executive_summary"]["building"]["text"])
        # Everything we wrote, and everything in it that is not the company's own quoted words or price list.
        company_text = {"pricing", "business_model"}
        for path, text in all_strings(out):
            if path[:2] and path[1] in company_text:
                continue
            self.assertFalse(fb.has_forbidden(text), (path, text))
        for key in all_keys(out):
            self.assertNotRegex(str(key), r"(?i)score|rating|percent|probab|grade")

    def test_text_that_rates_scores_or_names_an_investor_is_dropped_wherever_it_appears(self):
        bad = [
            "Product differentiation is strong at 85%.", "We rate the demand 7/10.", "Overall score: good.",
            "A high risk company.", "Likelihood of acceptance is moderate.", "Y Combinator would like this.",
            "Sequoia and a16z back companies like this.", "Traction level: low", "Chances of funding are good.",
            "Great potential here.", "Would suit an accelerator.",
        ]
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["executive_summary"]["building"] = stmt(bad[0], "c1")
        raw["opportunity"]["why_different"] = stmt(bad[1], "c1")
        raw["product"]["core_features"] = [stmt(t, "c3") for t in bad[2:6]]
        raw["risks"]["technical"] = [stmt(t, "c2") for t in bad[6:]]
        raw["missing_evidence"] = bad[:3]
        raw["readiness"][0]["shows"] = [stmt(t, "c1") for t in bad]
        raw["readiness"][0]["unknown"] = bad
        raw["readiness"][0]["question"] = "How strong is your demand, out of 10?"
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        self.assertEqual(out["executive_summary"]["building"]["status"], "unknown")
        self.assertEqual(out["opportunity"]["why_different"]["status"], "unknown")
        self.assertEqual(out["product_and_business_model"]["core_features"], [])
        self.assertEqual(out["evidence_and_risks"]["risks"]["technical"], [])
        first = out["readiness"][0]
        self.assertEqual((first["shows"], first["unknown"]), ([], []))
        self.assertEqual(first["question"], fb.DIMENSIONS[0][2])
        blob = json.dumps(out)
        for needle in ("85%", "7/10", "Combinator", "Sequoia", "a16z", "acceptance", "accelerator"):
            self.assertNotIn(needle, blob)

    def test_ratings_in_the_models_words_for_readiness_never_become_a_number_or_level(self):
        raw = good_raw()
        for entry in raw["readiness"]:
            entry["shows"] = [stmt("Rated high for clarity.", "c1"), stmt("The About page names the audience.", "c1")]
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        for dim in out["readiness"]:
            self.assertEqual([s["text"] for s in dim["shows"]], ["The About page names the audience."])
            self.assertEqual(set(dim), {"dimension", "label", "shows", "unknown", "question"})


class StatedTractionIsAlwaysUnverified(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_confirmed_claims_with_a_quote_become_traction_and_each_is_labelled(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), stored_brief())
        traction = out["evidence_and_risks"]["traction"]
        self.assertEqual([t["claim"] for t in traction],
                         ["More than 2,000 shops use Acme", "Replaces spreadsheets and QuickBooks"])
        for item in traction:
            self.assertEqual(item["label"], "Stated by the company, not verified")
            self.assertTrue(item["quote"])
            self.assertIn(item["source_url"], out["pages_read"])
        self.assertEqual(traction[0]["quote"], "More than 2,000 shops use Acme every week.")
        self.assertEqual(out["evidence_and_risks"]["traction_label"], "Stated by the company, not verified")

    def test_the_quote_is_the_stored_one_not_the_models_words(self):
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["traction_refs"] = ["c1"]
        raw["executive_summary"]["building"] = stmt("Acme has 10,000 shops.", "c1")
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        self.assertEqual(out["evidence_and_risks"]["traction"][0]["quote"], "More than 2,000 shops use Acme every week.")
        self.assertNotIn("10,000 shops", json.dumps(out["evidence_and_risks"]["traction"]))

    def test_no_traction_is_said_plainly(self):
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["traction_refs"] = []
        raw["missing_evidence"] = []
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        self.assertEqual(out["evidence_and_risks"]["traction"], [])
        self.assertTrue(any("No customer numbers" in m for m in out["evidence_and_risks"]["missing_evidence"]))


class EverythingHasASource(unittest.TestCase):
    def collect(self, value):
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            if "sources" in value or "source_url" in value:
                yield value
            for item in value.values():
                yield from self.collect(item)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            for item in value:
                yield from self.collect(item)

    def test_every_statement_and_traction_item_cites_a_page_that_was_read(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), stored_brief())
        read = set(out["pages_read"])
        found = 0
        for item in self.collect(out):
            urls = [s["url"] for s in item.get("sources", [])] + ([item["source_url"]] if "source_url" in item else [])
            if item.get("status") == "unknown":
                continue
            found += 1
            self.assertTrue(urls, item)
            self.assertTrue(set(urls) <= read, item)
        self.assertGreater(found, 10)

    def test_made_up_references_give_unknown_not_a_statement(self):
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["executive_summary"]["problem"] = stmt("Late invoices.", "c99", "x1", "https://made.up/")
        raw["executive_summary"]["solution"] = stmt("No refs at all.")
        raw["opportunity"]["target_users"] = {"text": "Shops.", "refs": "c1"}
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        for key in ("problem", "solution"):
            self.assertEqual(out["executive_summary"][key], {"text": "unknown", "sources": [], "status": "unknown"})
        self.assertEqual(out["opportunity"]["target_users"]["status"], "unknown")
        self.assertNotIn("made.up", json.dumps(out))

    def test_a_claim_whose_source_is_not_a_page_read_is_not_evidence(self):
        brief = stored_brief()
        brief["claims"][1]["source_url"] = "https://elsewhere.example/x"
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["executive_summary"]["for_whom"] = stmt("Anyone.", "c2")
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, brief)
        self.assertEqual(out["executive_summary"]["for_whom"]["status"], "unknown")

    def test_alternatives_are_only_those_the_cited_evidence_names(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), stored_brief())
        self.assertEqual([a["name"] for a in out["opportunity"]["alternatives"]], ["QuickBooks"])
        self.assertTrue(out["opportunity"]["alternatives"][0]["sources"])

    def test_our_assessments_are_labelled_and_still_cite_the_pages_read(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), stored_brief())
        self.assertEqual(out["opportunity"]["why_different"]["label"], "Our assessment")
        for kind, items in out["evidence_and_risks"]["risks"].items():
            self.assertTrue(items, kind)
            for item in items:
                self.assertEqual(item["label"], "Our assessment")
                self.assertTrue(item["sources"])
        self.assertEqual(out["evidence_and_risks"]["risks_label"], "Our assessment")

    def test_prices_and_the_business_model_are_copied_from_the_brief_and_labelled_inferred(self):
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["pricing"] = {"status": "published", "tiers": [{"name": "Gold", "price": "$1"}]}
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        pricing = out["product_and_business_model"]["pricing"]
        self.assertEqual(pricing["tiers"], stored_brief()["pricing"]["tiers"])
        self.assertEqual(out["product_and_business_model"]["business_model"]["label"], "inferred")
        brief = stored_brief()
        brief["pricing"] = {"status": "not_published", "tiers": [], "note": "No pricing page.", "source_urls": []}
        self.assertEqual(fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), brief)["product_and_business_model"]["pricing"]["status"],
                         "not_published")


class TheFixedNote(unittest.TestCase):
    NOTE = "Built only from the public website. It cannot judge the team, real demand, revenue or retention."

    def test_the_note_is_always_present_and_exact(self):

class NothingIsFetched(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_writing_it_uses_no_network_and_sends_only_stored_evidence_to_the_model(self):

class RunLifecycle(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        import founder_brief_run

        self.module = founder_brief_run
        self.updates: list[dict] = []

    async def _update(self, run_id, update):

    async def test_it_is_written_from_the_stored_brief_and_saved_on_the_run(self):
        async def load(source_id):
            self.assertEqual(source_id, "b1")

"""Tests for the founder brief.

Usage: python -m unittest test_founder_brief -v

No model is called and nothing is fetched: the model is a stand-in that returns whatever a test wants
(including things it must not be believed about), and the brief it works from is a stored product brief.

import json
import re
import unittest
from unittest import mock

import founder_brief as fb

HOME = "https://acme.example/"
ABOUT = "https://acme.example/about"
PRICING = "https://acme.example/pricing"


def stored_brief() -> dict:
    return {
        "version": 1, "url": HOME, "one_liner": "Acme tracks invoices for small shops.",
        "what_it_does": "Matches invoices to bank payments.", "who_its_for": "Small shops.",
        "how_it_works": "Connect your bank.", "primary_value": "Never chase a late invoice.",
        "pricing": {"status": "published", "note": "", "source_urls": [PRICING],
                    "tiers": [{"name": "Starter", "price": "$9 /month", "what_you_get": "One shop",
                               "source_url": PRICING}]},
        "business_model": {"label": "inferred", "model": "Subscription after a free trial",
                           "evidence": [{"quote": "Start your free trial today.", "source_url": HOME}]},
        "claims": [
            {"claim": "More than 2,000 shops use Acme", "source_url": ABOUT, "status": "confirmed",
             "quote": "More than 2,000 shops use Acme every week."},
            {"claim": "Works with any bank", "source_url": HOME, "status": "inferred", "quote": ""},
            {"claim": "Replaces spreadsheets and QuickBooks", "source_url": HOME, "status": "confirmed",
             "quote": "Replace your spreadsheets and QuickBooks."},
            {"claim": "Might do payroll", "source_url": HOME, "status": "unknown", "quote": ""},
        ],
        "unknowns": ["Who funds the company."],
        "suggested_journeys": [{"goal": "Start a free trial", "success": "A welcome page",
                                "source_url": HOME, "basis": "call_to_action",
                                "basis_text": "Start your free trial today", "claim_to_test": False}],
        "pages": [
            {"url": HOME, "kind": "home", "title": "Acme", "method": "http", "status": 200, "bytes": 10},
            {"url": ABOUT, "kind": "about", "title": "About", "method": "http", "status": 200, "bytes": 10},
            {"url": PRICING, "kind": "pricing", "title": "Pricing", "method": "http", "status": 200, "bytes": 10},
        ],
        "skipped": [], "limits": {"seconds": 1, "browser_reads": 0, "stopped": None},
    }


def stmt(text: str, *refs: str) -> dict:
    return {"text": text, "refs": list(refs)}


def good_raw() -> dict:
    return {
        "executive_summary": {
            "building": stmt("Acme builds invoice tracking for small shops.", "c1", "p1"),
            "for_whom": stmt("Small shops.", "c1"),
            "problem": stmt("Late invoices are hard to chase.", "j1"),
            "solution": stmt("It matches invoices to bank payments.", "c3"),
            "business_model": stmt("Subscription after a free trial, as we read it.", "e1", "t1"),
        },
        "opportunity": {
            "problem": stmt("Shops track invoices in spreadsheets.", "c3"),
            "alternatives": [{"name": "QuickBooks", "refs": ["c3"]}, {"name": "Xero", "refs": ["c3"]}],
            "target_users": stmt("Owners of small shops.", "c1"),
            "why_different": stmt("It targets very small shops rather than accountants.", "c1"),
        },
        "product": {
            "core_features": [stmt("Bank matching.", "c3"), stmt("Invented feature.", "c99")],
            "maturity_signals": [stmt("A public pricing page with one plan.", "t1")],
        },
        "traction_refs": ["c1", "c2", "c3", "c4", "p1", "c99"],
        "missing_evidence": ["No revenue figures are shown.", "No named customers."],
        "risks": {
            "technical": [stmt("Bank connections depend on third-party access.", "c2")],
            "competitive": [stmt("Established accounting tools already do this.", "c3")],
            "go_to_market": [stmt("The site gives no sign of how shops will find it.")],
        },
        "readiness": [
            {"dimension": key, "shows": [stmt(f"Public evidence for {key}.", "c1")], "unknown": ["Not stated."],
             "question": "What would you show someone to prove this?"}
            for key in fb.DIMENSION_KEYS
        ],
    }


def all_strings(value, skip=("quote",), path=()):
    """Every string in the output with its key path, except values under the skipped keys."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, item in value.items():
            if key in skip:
                continue
            yield from all_strings(item, skip, path + (key,))
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for index, item in enumerate(value):
            yield from all_strings(item, skip, path + (index,))
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        yield path, value


def all_keys(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, item in value.items():
            yield key
            yield from all_keys(item)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for item in value:
            yield from all_keys(item)


class NoScoreAnywhere(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_clean_report_has_no_score_rating_or_percentage_and_is_not_empty(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), stored_brief(), "b1")
        self.assertIn("Acme builds invoice tracking", out["executive_summary"]["building"]["text"])
        # Everything we wrote, and everything in it that is not the company's own quoted words or price list.
        company_text = {"pricing", "business_model"}
        for path, text in all_strings(out):
            if path[:2] and path[1] in company_text:
                continue
            self.assertFalse(fb.has_forbidden(text), (path, text))
        for key in all_keys(out):
            self.assertNotRegex(str(key), r"(?i)score|rating|percent|probab|grade")

    def test_text_that_rates_scores_or_names_an_investor_is_dropped_wherever_it_appears(self):
        bad = [
            "Product differentiation is strong at 85%.", "We rate the demand 7/10.", "Overall score: good.",
            "A high risk company.", "Likelihood of acceptance is moderate.", "Y Combinator would like this.",
            "Sequoia and a16z back companies like this.", "Traction level: low", "Chances of funding are good.",
            "Great potential here.", "Would suit an accelerator.",
        ]
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["executive_summary"]["building"] = stmt(bad[0], "c1")
        raw["opportunity"]["why_different"] = stmt(bad[1], "c1")
        raw["product"]["core_features"] = [stmt(t, "c3") for t in bad[2:6]]
        raw["risks"]["technical"] = [stmt(t, "c2") for t in bad[6:]]
        raw["missing_evidence"] = bad[:3]
        raw["readiness"][0]["shows"] = [stmt(t, "c1") for t in bad]
        raw["readiness"][0]["unknown"] = bad
        raw["readiness"][0]["question"] = "How strong is your demand, out of 10?"
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        self.assertEqual(out["executive_summary"]["building"]["status"], "unknown")
        self.assertEqual(out["opportunity"]["why_different"]["status"], "unknown")
        self.assertEqual(out["product_and_business_model"]["core_features"], [])
        self.assertEqual(out["evidence_and_risks"]["risks"]["technical"], [])
        first = out["readiness"][0]
        self.assertEqual((first["shows"], first["unknown"]), ([], []))
        self.assertEqual(first["question"], fb.DIMENSIONS[0][2])
        blob = json.dumps(out)
        for needle in ("85%", "7/10", "Combinator", "Sequoia", "a16z", "acceptance", "accelerator"):
            self.assertNotIn(needle, blob)

    def test_ratings_in_the_models_words_for_readiness_never_become_a_number_or_level(self):
        raw = good_raw()
        for entry in raw["readiness"]:
            entry["shows"] = [stmt("Rated high for clarity.", "c1"), stmt("The About page names the audience.", "c1")]
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        for dim in out["readiness"]:
            self.assertEqual([s["text"] for s in dim["shows"]], ["The About page names the audience."])
            self.assertEqual(set(dim), {"dimension", "label", "shows", "unknown", "question"})


class StatedTractionIsAlwaysUnverified(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_confirmed_claims_with_a_quote_become_traction_and_each_is_labelled(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), stored_brief())
        traction = out["evidence_and_risks"]["traction"]
        self.assertEqual([t["claim"] for t in traction],
                         ["More than 2,000 shops use Acme", "Replaces spreadsheets and QuickBooks"])
        for item in traction:
            self.assertEqual(item["label"], "Stated by the company, not verified")
            self.assertTrue(item["quote"])
            self.assertIn(item["source_url"], out["pages_read"])
        self.assertEqual(traction[0]["quote"], "More than 2,000 shops use Acme every week.")
        self.assertEqual(out["evidence_and_risks"]["traction_label"], "Stated by the company, not verified")

    def test_the_quote_is_the_stored_one_not_the_models_words(self):
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["traction_refs"] = ["c1"]
        raw["executive_summary"]["building"] = stmt("Acme has 10,000 shops.", "c1")
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        self.assertEqual(out["evidence_and_risks"]["traction"][0]["quote"], "More than 2,000 shops use Acme every week.")
        self.assertNotIn("10,000 shops", json.dumps(out["evidence_and_risks"]["traction"]))

    def test_no_traction_is_said_plainly(self):
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["traction_refs"] = []
        raw["missing_evidence"] = []
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        self.assertEqual(out["evidence_and_risks"]["traction"], [])
        self.assertTrue(any("No customer numbers" in m for m in out["evidence_and_risks"]["missing_evidence"]))


class EverythingHasASource(unittest.TestCase):
    def collect(self, value):
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            if "sources" in value or "source_url" in value:
                yield value
            for item in value.values():
                yield from self.collect(item)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            for item in value:
                yield from self.collect(item)

    def test_every_statement_and_traction_item_cites_a_page_that_was_read(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), stored_brief())
        read = set(out["pages_read"])
        found = 0
        for item in self.collect(out):
            urls = [s["url"] for s in item.get("sources", [])] + ([item["source_url"]] if "source_url" in item else [])
            if item.get("status") == "unknown":
                continue
            found += 1
            self.assertTrue(urls, item)
            self.assertTrue(set(urls) <= read, item)
        self.assertGreater(found, 10)

    def test_made_up_references_give_unknown_not_a_statement(self):
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["executive_summary"]["problem"] = stmt("Late invoices.", "c99", "x1", "https://made.up/")
        raw["executive_summary"]["solution"] = stmt("No refs at all.")
        raw["opportunity"]["target_users"] = {"text": "Shops.", "refs": "c1"}
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        for key in ("problem", "solution"):
            self.assertEqual(out["executive_summary"][key], {"text": "unknown", "sources": [], "status": "unknown"})
        self.assertEqual(out["opportunity"]["target_users"]["status"], "unknown")
        self.assertNotIn("made.up", json.dumps(out))

    def test_a_claim_whose_source_is_not_a_page_read_is_not_evidence(self):
        brief = stored_brief()
        brief["claims"][1]["source_url"] = "https://elsewhere.example/x"
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["executive_summary"]["for_whom"] = stmt("Anyone.", "c2")
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, brief)
        self.assertEqual(out["executive_summary"]["for_whom"]["status"], "unknown")

    def test_alternatives_are_only_those_the_cited_evidence_names(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), stored_brief())
        self.assertEqual([a["name"] for a in out["opportunity"]["alternatives"]], ["QuickBooks"])
        self.assertTrue(out["opportunity"]["alternatives"][0]["sources"])

    def test_our_assessments_are_labelled_and_still_cite_the_pages_read(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), stored_brief())
        self.assertEqual(out["opportunity"]["why_different"]["label"], "Our assessment")
        for kind, items in out["evidence_and_risks"]["risks"].items():
            self.assertTrue(items, kind)
            for item in items:
                self.assertEqual(item["label"], "Our assessment")
                self.assertTrue(item["sources"])
        self.assertEqual(out["evidence_and_risks"]["risks_label"], "Our assessment")

    def test_prices_and_the_business_model_are_copied_from_the_brief_and_labelled_inferred(self):
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["pricing"] = {"status": "published", "tiers": [{"name": "Gold", "price": "$1"}]}
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        pricing = out["product_and_business_model"]["pricing"]
        self.assertEqual(pricing["tiers"], stored_brief()["pricing"]["tiers"])
        self.assertEqual(out["product_and_business_model"]["business_model"]["label"], "inferred")
        brief = stored_brief()
        brief["pricing"] = {"status": "not_published", "tiers": [], "note": "No pricing page.", "source_urls": []}
        self.assertEqual(fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), brief)["product_and_business_model"]["pricing"]["status"],
                         "not_published")


class TheFixedNote(unittest.TestCase):
    NOTE = "Built only from the public website. It cannot judge the team, real demand, revenue or retention."

    def test_the_note_is_always_present_and_exact(self):
        self.assertEqual(fb.FOUNDER_NOTE, self.NOTE)
        for raw in (good_raw(), {}, None, [], "junk", {"note": "No note needed.", "executive_summary": 5}):
            out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            self.assertEqual(out["note"], self.NOTE)
            self.assertEqual(list(out)[2], "note", "the note comes first in the report")

    def test_a_useless_reply_still_gives_all_sections_of_unknowns_and_six_dimensions(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief({}, stored_brief())
        self.assertEqual([d["dimension"] for d in out["readiness"]], fb.DIMENSION_KEYS)
        self.assertEqual(len(out["readiness"]), 6)
        self.assertTrue(all(d["question"].endswith("?") for d in out["readiness"]))
        self.assertEqual(out["executive_summary"]["building"]["status"], "unknown")


class NothingIsFetched(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_writing_it_uses_no_network_and_sends_only_stored_evidence_to_the_model(self):
        import httpx

        prompts = []

        async def model(prompt):
            prompts.append(prompt)
            return good_raw()

        boom = mock.Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("the founder brief must not fetch anything"))
        with mock.patch.object(httpx.AsyncClient, "stream", boom), mock.patch.object(httpx.AsyncClient, "send", boom), \
                mock.patch("egress.EgressGuard.start", boom), mock.patch("site_reader.SiteReader.get", boom):
            out = await fb.founder_brief(stored_brief(), "b1", fb.TokenTally(), model)
        boom.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(out["source_brief_id"], "b1")
        self.assertIn("[c1] claim [confirmed]", prompts[0])
        self.assertIn("More than 2,000 shops use Acme every week.", prompts[0])

    async def test_a_brief_with_no_pages_is_refused(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            await fb.founder_brief({"claims": [], "pages": []}, "b", fb.TokenTally(), mock.AsyncMock())

    async def test_an_incomplete_reply_is_asked_for_again_then_fails(self):
        replies = iter([{"executive_summary": {}}, good_raw()])

        async def fake(prompt, usage):
            return next(replies)

        with mock.patch.object(fb, "_one_reply", fake):
            raw = await fb._ask_model("p", fb.TokenTally())
        self.assertEqual(fb.missing_sections(raw), [])

        async def always_short(prompt, usage):
            return {"executive_summary": {}}

        with mock.patch.object(fb, "_one_reply", always_short):
            with self.assertRaises(fb.FounderBriefIncomplete):
                await fb._ask_model("p", fb.TokenTally())


class RunLifecycle(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        import founder_brief_run

        self.module = founder_brief_run
        self.updates: list[dict] = []

    async def _update(self, run_id, update):
        self.updates.append({"id": run_id, **update})

    async def test_it_is_written_from_the_stored_brief_and_saved_on_the_run(self):
        async def load(source_id):
            self.assertEqual(source_id, "b1")
            return stored_brief()

        async def write(brief, source_id, usage):
            return fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), brief, source_id)

        await self.module.execute_founder_brief(
            {"id": "f1", "brief_run_id": "b1"}, "v", load=load, write=write, update=self._update)
        (saved,) = self.updates
        self.assertEqual(saved["status"], "done")
        self.assertEqual(saved["brief"]["note"], fb.FOUNDER_NOTE)

    async def test_without_a_finished_product_brief_the_run_fails_with_a_message(self):
        async def load(source_id):
            return None

        await self.module.execute_founder_brief(
            {"id": "f2", "brief_run_id": "b1"}, "v", load=load, write=mock.AsyncMock(), update=self._update)
        (saved,) = self.updates
        self.assertEqual(saved["status"], "failed")
        self.assertEqual(saved["brief"]["status"], "could_not_write")

    async def test_a_model_failure_fails_the_run_without_leaking_the_error_to_the_page(self):
        async def load(source_id):
            return stored_brief()

        async def write(brief, source_id, usage):
            raise RuntimeError("boom with detail")

        await self.module.execute_founder_brief(
            {"id": "f3", "brief_run_id": "b1"}, "v", load=load, write=write, update=self._update)
        (saved,) = self.updates
        self.assertEqual(saved["status"], "failed")
        self.assertNotIn("boom", saved["brief"]["message"])

    async def test_the_worker_hands_founder_brief_runs_to_this_path(self):
        import worker_run

        with mock.patch("founder_brief_run.execute_founder_brief", new=mock.AsyncMock()) as handler:
            await worker_run.execute({"id": "f4", "kind": "founder_brief", "brief_run_id": "b1"}, "v")
        handler.assert_awaited_once()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class EverythingHasASource(unittest.TestCase):
    def collect(self, value):
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            if "sources" in value or "source_url" in value:
                yield value
            for item in value.values():
                yield from self.collect(item)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            for item in value:
                yield from self.collect(item)

    def test_every_statement_and_traction_item_cites_a_page_that_was_read(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), stored_brief())
        read = set(out["pages_read"])
        found = 0
        for item in self.collect(out):
            urls = [s["url"] for s in item.get("sources", [])] + ([item["source_url"]] if "source_url" in item else [])
            if item.get("status") == "unknown":
                continue
            found += 1
            self.assertTrue(urls, item)
            self.assertTrue(set(urls) <= read, item)
        self.assertGreater(found, 10)

    def test_made_up_references_give_unknown_not_a_statement(self):
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["executive_summary"]["problem"] = stmt("Late invoices.", "c99", "x1", "https://made.up/")
        raw["executive_summary"]["solution"] = stmt("No refs at all.")
        raw["opportunity"]["target_users"] = {"text": "Shops.", "refs": "c1"}
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        for key in ("problem", "solution"):
            self.assertEqual(out["executive_summary"][key], {"text": "unknown", "sources": [], "status": "unknown"})
        self.assertEqual(out["opportunity"]["target_users"]["status"], "unknown")
        self.assertNotIn("made.up", json.dumps(out))

    def test_a_claim_whose_source_is_not_a_page_read_is_not_evidence(self):
        brief = stored_brief()
        brief["claims"][1]["source_url"] = "https://elsewhere.example/x"
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["executive_summary"]["for_whom"] = stmt("Anyone.", "c2")
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, brief)
        self.assertEqual(out["executive_summary"]["for_whom"]["status"], "unknown")

    def test_alternatives_are_only_those_the_cited_evidence_names(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), stored_brief())
        self.assertEqual([a["name"] for a in out["opportunity"]["alternatives"]], ["QuickBooks"])
        self.assertTrue(out["opportunity"]["alternatives"][0]["sources"])

    def test_our_assessments_are_labelled_and_still_cite_the_pages_read(self):
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), stored_brief())
        self.assertEqual(out["opportunity"]["why_different"]["label"], "Our assessment")
        for kind, items in out["evidence_and_risks"]["risks"].items():
            self.assertTrue(items, kind)
            for item in items:
                self.assertEqual(item["label"], "Our assessment")
                self.assertTrue(item["sources"])
        self.assertEqual(out["evidence_and_risks"]["risks_label"], "Our assessment")

    def test_prices_and_the_business_model_are_copied_from_the_brief_and_labelled_inferred(self):
        raw = good_raw()
        raw["pricing"] = {"status": "published", "tiers": [{"name": "Gold", "price": "$1"}]}
        out = fb.build_founder_brief(raw, stored_brief())
        pricing = out["product_and_business_model"]["pricing"]
        self.assertEqual(pricing["tiers"], stored_brief()["pricing"]["tiers"])
        self.assertEqual(out["product_and_business_model"]["business_model"]["label"], "inferred")
        brief = stored_brief()
        brief["pricing"] = {"status": "not_published", "tiers": [], "note": "No pricing page.", "source_urls": []}
        self.assertEqual(fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), brief)["product_and_business_model"]["pricing"]["status"],
                         "not_published")

class RunLifecycle(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        import founder_brief_run

        self.module = founder_brief_run
        self.updates: list[dict] = []

    async def _update(self, run_id, update):
        self.updates.append({"id": run_id, **update})

    async def test_it_is_written_from_the_stored_brief_and_saved_on_the_run(self):
        async def load(source_id):
            self.assertEqual(source_id, "b1")
            return stored_brief()

        async def write(brief, source_id, usage):
            return fb.build_founder_brief(good_raw(), brief, source_id)

        await self.module.execute_founder_brief(
            {"id": "f1", "brief_run_id": "b1"}, "v", load=load, write=write, update=self._update)
        (saved,) = self.updates
        self.assertEqual(saved["status"], "done")
        self.assertEqual(saved["brief"]["note"], fb.FOUNDER_NOTE)

    async def test_without_a_finished_product_brief_the_run_fails_with_a_message(self):
        async def load(source_id):
            return None

        await self.module.execute_founder_brief(
            {"id": "f2", "brief_run_id": "b1"}, "v", load=load, write=mock.AsyncMock(), update=self._update)
        (saved,) = self.updates
        self.assertEqual(saved["status"], "failed")
        self.assertEqual(saved["brief"]["status"], "could_not_write")

    async def test_a_model_failure_fails_the_run_without_leaking_the_error_to_the_page(self):
        async def load(source_id):
            return stored_brief()

        async def write(brief, source_id, usage):
            raise RuntimeError("boom with detail")

        await self.module.execute_founder_brief(
            {"id": "f3", "brief_run_id": "b1"}, "v", load=load, write=write, update=self._update)
        (saved,) = self.updates
        self.assertEqual(saved["status"], "failed")
        self.assertNotIn("boom", saved["brief"]["message"])

    async def test_the_worker_hands_founder_brief_runs_to_this_path(self):
        import worker_run

        with mock.patch("founder_brief_run.execute_founder_brief", new=mock.AsyncMock()) as handler:
            await worker_run.execute({"id": "f4", "kind": "founder_brief", "brief_run_id": "b1"}, "v")
        handler.assert_awaited_once()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

### 2026-10-12 — Founder brief: a second report from the stored product brief (behind a flag)

A founder-facing read of the same public evidence, in the Understand mode. Not committed.

- **What it is.** `worker/founder_brief.py` writes four sections (executive summary; the opportunity; product and business model; evidence and risks) and a readiness section of six separate dimensions: problem and customer clarity, product differentiation, evidence of demand, distribution, traction evidence, business model clarity. Each dimension has what the public evidence shows (with sources), what is unknown, and a question to be ready for. There is no score, rating, percentage or probability, and no accelerator or investor is named.
- **Fixed note at the top, always:** "Built only from the public website. It cannot judge the team, real demand, revenue or retention." Set in code (`FOUNDER_NOTE`), shown by the page from its own constant.
- **No new crawl.** It is written from the stored product brief only (its claims and quotes, prices, business-model evidence, calls to action, pages read). A test makes any fetch fail the build.
- **The model proposes, code enforces.** Statements carry evidence ids; the source links and quotes come from the stored evidence, never from the model's words, and a statement with no valid id is "unknown". Stated traction can only be a claim the product brief confirmed with a page quote, is shown with that quote and is always labelled "Stated by the company, not verified". Alternatives are kept only if the cited evidence names them. Prices and the business model are copied from the product brief (business model labelled inferred). Risks and "why it may be different" are labelled "Our assessment" and cite the pages they rest on. Any sentence we write that contains a percentage, a score, a rating, a high/medium/low level, odds, an acceptance idea or a named accelerator or investor is dropped.
- **On demand, traced.** `POST /api/briefs/[id]/founder` queues a run of kind `founder_brief` (`brief_run_id` = the product brief); the worker claims it (`worker_run.execute` dispatches to `founder_brief_run.py`), writes it under a `founder_brief` span and saves it in that run's `brief` column. The page polls `GET /api/briefs/[id]/founder`. Asked again, it reuses the existing one.
- **Flag.** Off unless `NEXT_PUBLIC_FOUNDER_BRIEF` is on (`on`, `1`, `true`, `yes`); the API routes check it too. With it on, the brief page has a Product brief / Founder brief toggle.
- **SQL.** `supabase/schema.sql`, section "Founder brief": `runs.kind` also allows `founder_brief`, and `enqueue_founder_brief_run`. It must be run before the toggle can ask for one.
- **Found on the first real call.** The small model stopped after the first section when given the whole nested schema at once (3 of 3 tries). It is now asked in three smaller parts, each checked for completeness and retried; a real brief of plausible.io then came back whole in 3 calls for $0.003.

Tests: `test_founder_brief.py` (no score, rating or percentage anywhere in the output other than the company's own quoted words and price list; stated traction always labelled and quoted from the stored claim; every statement and traction item cites a page that was read; the fixed note always present, even for a junk reply; no network; incomplete replies retried; the run's lifecycle) and `founder-logic.test.ts` (flag, fixed words).

Limits to know:
- The company's own words are shown verbatim, so a quote can contain a percentage ("99.99% uptime"); the no-percentage rule is about what we write. Quotes are labelled as the company's.
- The word filter is a list of patterns, not a judge of meaning: a rating written in an unusual way could pass. The prompt forbids it too.
- Page text is not stored with the brief, so traction can only come from claims the product brief already confirmed; a figure the brief did not capture is not in the founder brief.
- The page was typechecked and built but not looked at with a real founder brief row until the SQL is run.
EOF
echo ok

content.text:
The founder brief is built, tested and flagged off by default; one SQL block has to be run before the toggle can ask for one.

## SQL
It is appended to `supabase/schema.sql` under "Founder brief" (safe to re-run):

```sql
alter table public.runs drop constraint if exists runs_kind_check;
alter table public.runs add constraint runs_kind_check
  check (kind in ('test', 'understand', 'founder_brief'));

create or replace function public.enqueue_founder_brief_run(
  p_brief_id uuid, p_ip_hash text, p_max_queued integer, p_max_per_hour integer
) returns jsonb language plpgsql security invoker set search_path = '' as $$
declare source_url text; existing_id uuid; queued_count integer; recent_count integer;
        oldest_recent timestamptz; new_id uuid;
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('public.enqueue_web_run'));
  select url into source_url from public.runs
   where id = p_brief_id and kind = 'understand' and status = 'done' and brief is not null;
  if source_url is null then return jsonb_build_object('error', 'no_brief'); end if;
  select id into existing_id from public.runs
   where brief_run_id = p_brief_id and kind = 'founder_brief' and status in ('queued','running','done')
   order by created_at desc limit 1;
  if existing_id is not null then return jsonb_build_object('id', existing_id); end if;
  select count(*) into queued_count from public.runs where status = 'queued';
  if queued_count >= p_max_queued then return jsonb_build_object('error', 'queue_full'); end if;
  select count(*), min(created_at) into recent_count, oldest_recent
    from public.runs where ip_hash = p_ip_hash and created_at > now() - interval '1 hour';
  if recent_count >= p_max_per_hour then
    return jsonb_build_object('error', 'rate_limited', 'retry_after_seconds',
      ceil(extract(epoch from (oldest_recent + interval '1 hour' - now())))::integer);
  end if;
  insert into public.runs (url, goal, source, ip_hash, kind, access_mode, brief_run_id)
  values (source_url, 'Founder brief', 'web', p_ip_hash, 'founder_brief', 'public', p_brief_id)
  returning id into new_id;
  return jsonb_build_object('id', new_id);
end; $$;
-- plus revoke from public/anon/authenticated and grant to service_role (in the file)
```

## What was built
- **Founder brief:** `worker/founder_brief.py` writes the executive summary, the opportunity, product and business model, and evidence and risks. It reuses the stored product brief and fetches nothing; a test makes any network call fail.
- **Readiness:** six separate dimensions (problem and customer clarity, differentiation, evidence of demand, distribution, traction evidence, business model clarity). Each has what the evidence shows (with sources), what is unknown, and a question to be ready for. There are no numbers, ratings, percentages or probabilities, and no accelerator or investor is named.
- **Fixed note:** "Built only from the public website. It cannot judge the team, real demand, revenue or retention." It is set in code and shown by the page from its own constant.
- **Enforcement in code:**
  - Statements cite evidence ids, and links and quotes come from the stored evidence, so a statement with no valid id becomes "unknown".
  - Stated traction can only be a claim the product brief confirmed with a page quote, shown with that quote and always labelled "Stated by the company, not verified".
  - Alternatives are kept only if the cited evidence names them.
  - Prices and the business model are copied from the product brief.
  - Risks and "why it may be different" are labelled "Our assessment" and cite the pages they rest on.
  - Any sentence we write with a score, rating, percentage, level, odds, acceptance language or a named investor is dropped.
- **On demand, traced:**
  - `POST /api/briefs/[id]/founder` queues a run of kind `founder_brief`, and the worker writes it under a `founder_brief` span and saves it in that run's `brief` column.
  - Asking again reuses the existing one.
  - The page polls `GET /api/briefs/[id]/founder`.
- **Flag:** `NEXT_PUBLIC_FOUNDER_BRIEF` (`on`, `1`, `true` or `yes`) is off by default, and the API routes check it too. With it on, the brief page shows a Product brief / Founder brief toggle.

## Verification
- **Run with neatlogs export off:** I set `NEATLOGS_DISABLE_EXPORT=1` for the test process only and left the shared test setup alone.
- **Worker:** 262 tests pass (27 live skipped with `SKIP_LIVE_TESTS=1`); the live render test passed separately.
- **Founder brief tests:** 22 tests cover your four: no score, rating or percentage in what we write; traction always labelled and quoted; every statement cited to a page read; the note always present.
- **Web:** 24 tests pass, typecheck, lint and build are clean, and the new `/api/briefs/[id]/founder` route is listed.
- **Secret scan:** 0 matches in the tree and 49 commits.
- **Real call:** I ran the model against the stored plausible.io brief, read from the database with no queue. It gave 7 sourced summary statements, 1 named alternative (Google Analytics), 1 stated traction item labelled unverified, and six readiness dimensions each with a question. Cost was $0.003.

## Things to know
- **Model stopping early:** it stopped after the first section when given the whole schema at once, on 3 of 3 tries. It is now asked in three smaller parts, each checked and retried, which is why a run is 3 calls.
- **Quotes may contain percentages:** a company's own quote can contain "99.99% uptime". The no-percentage rule covers what we write, and quotes are shown verbatim and labelled as the company's.
- **Word filter is a pattern list:** it is not a judge of meaning, so an unusually phrased rating could pass. The prompt forbids it too.
- **Traction limit:** page text isn't stored with the brief, so traction can only come from claims the product brief already confirmed.
- **Page not seen with real data:** the founder tab was typechecked and built but not viewed with a real founder row, since the SQL isn't run yet. Once it is, I can create a founder run for the plausible.io brief and check it at both widths as I did for the product brief.
- **Old worker risk:** an older worker would claim a `founder_brief` run as a test run, as with understand runs.

import asyncio, base64, json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, urllib.request
import websockets

CHROME = r"C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"
BASE = "http://localhost:3458"
ID = "8ca3896f-a3d8-475f-b810-5c9b6b98bb9e"
OUT = sys.argv[1]


class Cdp:
    def __init__(self, ws):
        self.ws, self.n = ws, 0

    async def send(self, method, **params):
        self.n += 1
        i = self.n
        await self.ws.send(json.dumps({"id": i, "method": method, "params": params}))
        while True:
            m = json.loads(await self.ws.recv())
            if m.get("id") == i:
                if "error" in m:
                    raise RuntimeError(m["error"])
                return m.get("result", {})

    async def js(self, expr):
        r = await self.send("Runtime.evaluate", expression=expr, returnByValue=True, awaitPromise=True)
        return r.get("result", {}).get("value")

    async def shot(self, name):
        m = await self.send("Page.getLayoutMetrics")
        c = m["cssContentSize"]
        r = await self.send("Page.captureScreenshot", format="png", captureBeyondViewport=True,
                            clip={"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": c["width"], "height": min(c["height"], 7000), "scale": 1})
        open(f"{OUT}/{name}.png", "wb").write(base64.b64decode(r["data"]))


async def main():
    prof = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    p = subprocess.Popen([CHROME, "--headless=new", "--remote-debugging-port=9334", f"--user-data-dir={prof}",
                          "--no-first-run", "--disable-gpu", "about:blank"], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                         stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    try:
        for _ in range(40):
            try:
                tabs = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:9334/json"))
                break
            except Exception:
                time.sleep(0.5)
        page = next(t for t in tabs if t["type"] == "page")
        report = {}
        async with websockets.connect(page["webSocketDebuggerUrl"], max_size=None) as ws:
            c = Cdp(ws)
            await c.send("Page.enable")
            await c.send("Runtime.enable")
            for name, w, h, mobile in (("desktop", 1280, 900, False), ("phone", 390, 844, True)):
                await c.send("Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", width=w, height=h, deviceScaleFactor=1, mobile=mobile)
                await c.send("Page.navigate", url=f"{BASE}/brief/{ID}")
                await asyncio.sleep(6)
                tabs_present = await c.js("[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]')].map(t=>t.textContent.trim())")
                await c.js("[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]')].find(t=>t.textContent.trim()==='Founder brief').click()")
                await asyncio.sleep(4)
                await c.shot(f"founder-{name}")
                report[name] = await c.js("""({
                  tabs: %s,
                  scrollW: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, innerW: window.innerWidth,
                  note: document.body.innerText.includes('Built only from the public website. It cannot judge the team, real demand, revenue or retention.'),
                  h2: [...document.querySelectorAll('h2')].map(e=>e.textContent),
                  dimensions: [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].map(e=>e.textContent.trim()).filter(t=>/clarity|differentiation|demand|Distribution|Traction evidence|Business model clarity/i.test(t)),
                  beReady: [...document.querySelectorAll('p')].filter(p=>p.previousElementSibling && /Be ready/.test(p.previousElementSibling.textContent)).map(p=>p.textContent),
                  tractionLabels: [...document.querySelectorAll('p')].filter(p=>p.textContent.trim()==='Stated by the company, not verified').length,
                  links: [...new Set([...document.querySelectorAll('main a')].map(a=>a.href))],
                  badLinks: [...document.querySelectorAll('main a')].filter(a=>!/^https?:/.test(a.href)).length,
                  unlinkedTarget: [...document.querySelectorAll('main a[href^=http]')].filter(a=>a.target!=='_blank' || !/noopener/.test(a.rel)).length
                })""" % json.dumps(tabs_present))
        print(json.dumps(report, indent=1))
    finally:
        p.terminate()


asyncio.run(main())
